title: bourreria spathulata
intro: Bourreria spathulata, commonly known as "Lion's Tail", is a plant species within the family Boraginaceae. The health benefits of Bourreria spathulata include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Bourreria spathulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
